verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own corporations page publishes at least one exact dollar amount: a $150 same-day in-person service fee. It also notes that nonprofits and LLPs can file the Initial Report at formation without an additional fee. The other cited pages (formation, foreign registration, annual report, closure, certificates) show only titles, with no fee amounts. missing for 10: published dollar amounts for core transactions such as domestic formation, foreign registration, annual report, closure, certificates and apostilles, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that a fee schedule is posted rather than only shown at checkout.
